title: 15 Assets That Pay You Every Month
description:
Imagine money arriving every month from things you own, not from your job. In this video I walk through 15 assets that can pay you monthly, from three angles: the numbers (savings, money market funds, T-bills, CDs, bond funds), the psychology of higher-yield traps (dividends, REITs, rentals, covered calls, annuities), and a playbook to build your own monthly income machine in layers.

Get The Ryan Rover Money Playbook: [LINK HERE]

0:00 Intro
1:51 How we got the numbers
2:17 Angle 1: The Numbers
2:24 1. High yield savings account
4:10 2. Money market funds
5:49 3. Treasury bill ladder
7:21 4. CDs with monthly interest
8:49 5. Bond funds
10:33 Angle 2: The Psychology
10:50 6. Monthly dividend stocks and ETFs
12:36 7. REITs
14:16 8. Rental property
16:06 9. Covered call ETFs
17:36 10. Income annuities
19:31 Angle 3: The Playbook
19:57 11. A staggered dividend portfolio
21:25 12. A small business
22:46 13. Royalties and digital products
24:03 14. A paid off home
25:27 15. Delayed Social Security
26:54 Building your monthly income machine
28:24 Monthly income at every age
29:22 Two income investors
30:32 Questions people ask
32:33 Monthly income mistakes
33:39 Recap
34:28 What to do next

Sources:
- FDIC and NCUA: deposit insurance coverage limits
- TreasuryDirect and U.S. Treasury: Treasury bills, state tax exemption
- SEC investor bulletins: money market funds, bond funds, covered call and income products, annuities
- IRS: REIT distribution requirements, taxation of REIT dividends
- Realty Income: 'The Monthly Dividend Company' (company materials)
- Social Security Administration: delayed retirement credits (about 8% per year to age 70)
- Yaari (1965) and the 'annuity puzzle' literature
- Yields and rates mentioned are illustrations; current rates vary
